snippet.title: Trafficity — a city builder focused on traffic — gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5185750/Trafficity

Trafficity is a brand new city builder game where roads and traffic are the stars of the show.

Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.
